title: How Anthropic ships Claude with Claude: Separating the Brain from the Hands
author: swyx .ai
description: Katelyn Lesse and Angela Jiang on Opus 5.5, the Claude Platform, and the engineering behind AI agents.
summary: Watch the full episode on YouTube As we learned from the Anthropic S-1 filings yesterday , the lab has some of the highest revenue and research efficiency in human history, particularly with -126% loss to 19% GAAP profit turnaround in the last year. The company credits this to their two core loops: Improvement and Investment: Today we go inside how Anthropic works.
takeaways: Now the dust has settled on Opus 5.5 and it has lasted a month as the generally accepted #1 LLM in the world, we dive into its launch, and how Anthropic ships Claude with Claude with Katelyn Lesse and Angela Jiang , heads of Engineering and Product respectively.
Memory and learning remain important, but the team says more of its immediate attention has moved to safety as model launches have become harder.
A model launch is also an API launch Anthropic's Opus 5.5 launch emphasizes both model quality and cost.
